```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r chargement}
FICHIER <- "Note globale.xlsx"

# --- NAC /20 → /10 -----------------------------------------------------------
nac <- read_excel(FICHIER, sheet = "NAC") |>
  select(
    Nom     = `Nom de famille`,
    Prénom  = Prénom,
    email   = `Adresse de courriel`,
    note_nac_20 = `Note/20,00`
  ) |>
  mutate(
    note_nac_20 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(note_nac_20)),
    `NAC /10`   = round(note_nac_20 / 2, 2)
  ) |>
  select(Nom, Prénom, email, `NAC /10`)

# --- Nutrition théorique /4 --------------------------------------------------
nt <- read_excel(FICHIER, sheet = "Nutrition théorique") |>
  select(
    email         = `Adresse de courriel`,
    `Nutri. théo. /4` = `Note/4,00`
  ) |>
  mutate(`Nutri. théo. /4` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Nutri. théo. /4`)))

# --- Nutrition pratique /6 ---------------------------------------------------
np <- read_excel(FICHIER, sheet = "Nutrition pratique") |>
  select(
    email            = email,
    `Nutri. prat. /6` = note_sur_6
  ) |>
  mutate(`Nutri. prat. /6` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Nutri. prat. /6`)))

# --- Fusion ------------------------------------------------------------------
recap <- nac |>
  left_join(nt, by = "email") |>
  left_join(np, by = "email") |>
  mutate(
    Total = round(
      rowSums(cbind(`NAC /10`, `Nutri. théo. /4`, `Nutri. prat. /6`),
              na.rm = FALSE),
      2
    )
  ) |>
  select(-email) |>
  arrange(Nom, Prénom)
```

## Notes par étudiant

```{r tableau}
recap |>
  kable(
    digits  = 2,
    align   = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    col.names = c("Nom", "Prénom", "NAC /10", "Nutri. théo. /4", "Nutri. prat. /6", "Total /20")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) |>
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r export_xlsx}
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Notes récap")

# En-têtes
header_style <- createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill = "#4472C4", fontColour = "white",
  halign = "center", border = "Bottom"
)
data_style  <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.00")
total_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.00",
                           textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#D9E1F2")

writeData(wb, "Notes récap", recap, startRow = 1, headerStyle = header_style)
addStyle(wb, "Notes récap", data_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(recap) + 1), cols = 3:6, gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Notes récap", total_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(recap) + 1), cols = 6)

setColWidths(wb, "Notes récap", cols = 1:2, widths = 22)
setColWidths(wb, "Notes récap", cols = 3:6, widths = 16)

# Renommer les colonnes dans le fichier
colnames(recap) <- c("Nom", "Prénom", "NAC /10", "Nutri. théo. /4", "Nutri. prat. /6", "Total /20")
writeData(wb, "Notes récap", recap, startRow = 1, headerStyle = header_style)

saveWorkbook(wb, "notes_recap_examen_S4.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Export xlsx : notes_recap_examen_S4.xlsx\n")
```

```{r stats, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  "\n**%d étudiants** — Moyenne totale : **%.2f / 20**\n",
  nrow(recap),
  mean(recap$Total, na.rm = TRUE)
))
```
